scope: execution budget and devices only; cases, rows, row order, resolutions, dt values, controlled variables, metrics, convergence definitions and every threshold are unchanged
reason: cuda:1 is shared with concurrent WP-12 agents (Phase 4c geometry/material and Phase 3 surface runs), so formal rows run about 3.6x slower than the DEV estimate (1 mm CUT 128 s vs 35 s) and the declared cap would drop late rows as NOT_RUN for resource contention, not for any property of the rows. No formal result was inspected to make this change; it is decided from wall-time contention alone.

changes.devices: rows may run on cuda:0 and cuda:1, at most 2 concurrent per device; every result.json records the device; device is not a controlled scientific variable for kinematic rows (GPU float32 atomics nondeterminism band applies, ADR 0012)
changes.rule_unchanged: rows not started when the amended cap is reached are NOT_RUN (budget) and reported
